analyze_clips_on_boot.label: Analyze avatar clips on startup
analyze_clips_on_boot.description: Extract beat/timing metadata for animation clips at boot (mtime-cached). Off = skip; the motion catalog uses whatever metadata already exists.

lipsync_engine.label: Lipsync engine
lipsync_engine.description: How the avatar's mouth moves while speaking. 'amplitude' = simple TTS RMS to jaw-open. 'neurosync' = full ARKit mouth driven by real phoneme visemes from the NeuroSync model (needs the ~1GB weights; set it up in Behavior > Speech). Hot-toggleable; no restart needed.
